headerDisplay: Before you rely on this: set the valve's own alarm limits first, in the Shelly app or the valve's web page (Config tab): water temperature, pressure and, above all, flow, each with the action Close. They are mastered on the valve and this plugin never changes them; out of the box the flow limit is far too high to ever trip. The plugin reads them at every start, logs them, and warns here in the log if they look unset. Then choose the optional rules below. Shows the valve in Apple Home, with optional temperature, pressure and flow tiles, and saves a snapshot of the readings every few minutes for other tools to read.

homeSensors.title: Show temperature, pressure and flow in Apple Home

homeUnits.title: Units for pressure and flow in Apple Home
homeUnits.description: Same as the valve follows the units chosen on the valve's own page, so the numbers match what you see there. Snapshots, the On Cue app and Backstage always use bar and litres.

controlType.title: Control in Apple Home
controlType.description: Switch: a plain On/Off switch, On = water open. Valve: Home's water faucet tile, which shows as running or in use whenever the valve is open, even with no water flowing.

valveSensors.title: Add a Closed sensor and an Alarm sensor to Apple Home
valveSensors.description: Home cannot notify when a valve changes. Closed is a contact sensor (Closed = water off). Alarm trips when the valve shuts without Home telling it to (a valve alarm, the Shelly app or the button), and clears when it opens. Turn on notifications for them in the Home app.

alertAfterMinutes.title: Alert when water has run for (minutes)
alertAfterMinutes.description: Trips the 'running too long' sensor when water has flowed without stopping for this long. 0 turns it off. A bath or garden hose can take this long, so choose what is normal for the home.

ignoreFlowBelowLitresPerMinute.title: Ignore flow below (litres a minute)
ignoreFlowBelowLitresPerMinute.description: Flow at or below this does not count as water running, for the 'running too long' sensor and holiday mode. Use it for an ice maker or a slow top-up (0.5 is a good start; a tap is several litres a minute). Higher values hide slower real leaks.

alertAfterLitres.title: Alert when a run has used (litres)
alertAfterLitres.description: Same sensor, triggered by volume. 0 turns it off.

shutOffAfterMinutes.title: Shut the water off after (minutes)
shutOffAfterMinutes.description: Closes the valve when water has flowed without stopping for this long. 0 (the default) never shuts it off. The alert stays on until the valve is opened again. This stops a burst pipe but would also cut a bath or hose left running on purpose.

shutOffAfterLitres.title: Shut the water off after a run has used (litres)
shutOffAfterLitres.description: Same, triggered by volume. 0 never shuts it off.

holidayMode.title: Add a Holiday mode switch to Apple Home
holidayMode.description: While it is on, water running for a few minutes trips the 'running too long' sensor, because nobody should be using water. Home remembers the switch across restarts. Turn it on when the home is empty.

holidayAlertMinutes.title: In holiday mode, alert after water has run for (minutes)

holidayShutOffMinutes.title: In holiday mode, shut the water off after (minutes)
holidayShutOffMinutes.description: 0 (the default) never shuts it off. Ten is a sensible choice for an empty home: it closes the valve if water runs for ten minutes.

holidayAllowanceLitres.title: In holiday mode, alert when more than this many litres are used in 24 hours
holidayAllowanceLitres.description: Catches slow leaks that never make one long run, such as a dripping tap or a cistern refilling. Counted from the valve's own water counter while holiday mode is on. 0 (the default) turns it off. Choose a little above what an empty home really uses (a fridge ice maker, say).

slowLeakTest.title: Nightly slow leak test
slowLeakTest.description: Adds a 'Water Slow Leak Sensor'. In a short quiet window each night the valve's water counter should not move; if more than the allowance is used, the sensor trips and stays on until a later night passes. It only watches, it never closes the valve.

slowLeakTestTime.title: Slow leak test starts at (time)
slowLeakTestTime.description: 24-hour time on the Pi's clock, for example 03:00.

slowLeakTestLitres.title: Slow leak test allowance (litres)
slowLeakTestLitres.description: Water used in the window above this fails the test. A little above what an ice maker or cylinder top-up uses.

holidayIgnoreFrom.title: In holiday mode, ignore water from (time)
holidayIgnoreFrom.description: A daily window when holiday mode does not count water, for sprinklers or irrigation. 24-hour time on the Pi's clock, for example 05:00. The normal "running too long" limits still apply. Leave both empty for no window.

holidayIgnoreTo.title: In holiday mode, ignore water until (time)

atmosphericBar.title: Atmospheric pressure (bar)
atmosphericBar.description: The valve shows absolute pressure while no water flows. This is subtracted to give the real water pressure. 1.013 at sea level; lower at altitude.

historyDays.title: Days of history to keep in the snapshot file

snapshotDir.title: Folder for the snapshot file
snapshotDir.description: Leave empty to use a neo-valve folder inside Homebridge's storage folder.

switchName.title: Name of the On/Off switch in Apple Home

alarmName.title: Name of the critical fault sensor (the valve's own alarms)

holidayName.title: Name of the Holiday mode switch

suspectedLeakName.title: Name of the unexpected flow sensor (the plugin's own rules)

password.title: Password
password.description: The valve's device password. Leave empty if the valve has no password set.
